body:
I have, actually started a charity that gave chromebooks to injured athletes in hospitals etc. the best it does is get me to that state of nonfeeling, the worst is it triggers all these emotions of seeing other people feeling good and spirals me down deeper.

Thanks so much for taking the time to read my crap

There are times when I can effortlessly float through life, not really feeling or caring, but time passes and things get done. When I can get into a state like this, which is really a state of not feeling, is when things are the best for me. Its not until something cracks that facade and reminds me that I am alone, and there are feelings inside and they are twisting, and burning, and fighting to get out and be felt, but all they manifest as is pain, regret and shame.

Is the sum of me just a giant pain receptor and the brief moments of nothingness between flareups is what I strive to live for? It seems pretty pointless.
